title: A durable coating constructed by metal-organic framework and polyphosphazene for flame retardant cotton fabric with enhanced mechanical properties
treatment_method: Source control cotton; no coating. Extent of preparative ethanol/citric-acid treatment of the control is not explicitly resolved.
TG_locator: Official SI Table S2: nitrogen T5, Tmax and char at 800 C; main Figure 3a-b and section 3.2 identify the conventional TG series.
LOI_locator: Main section 3.3, p 6: exact initial LOI values 17.2, 18.4 and 24.8. Referenced Table S4 actually contains cone data, not LOI.
conditions_locator: Main section 2.5, p 3: conventional TG uses Mettler-Toledo, 8 mg, nitrogen and 10 C/min. Separate TG-DSC settings are not transferred.
pairing_evidence: Exact cotton and coating labels match original LOI prose and official Table S2. Preparation distinguishes one versus two St/PZS immersions. Post-laundering LOI has no matched TG and is excluded. Conventional TG remains separate from TG-DSC and TG-IR.
source_location: Main pp 2-3,5-7 and official supplementary Tables S1-S8.
limitations: Main PDF methods and Figure 3/LOI prose visually checked; official SI native tables read. No air heating rate is inferred from nitrogen methods. UiO-66 T5 conflicts with universal lower-than-control prose and is withheld. PZS bath quantity conflicts with SI and is withheld. Rmax units/values conflict and are omitted. The stated 200.1% residue increase is arithmetically inconsistent and is not used. Control pretreatment is not inferred. Washed specimen label conflicts (10 versus 20 cycles) are held.
